description: Mutes single channels of a polyphonic cable, passing the first eight through

params.text: Sets how long a mute or unmute fades over, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant
Silences that channel of the polyphonic cable

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable whose channels are muted; only its first eight are read

outputs.text: The same cable with the muted channels silenced, or with them removed when Shrink channels is ticked

notes: the display counts the channels arriving at the IN jack, in red, or the channels leaving the OUT jack in green when 'Show OUT channels' is ticked.
menu: Show OUT channels — counts the channels leaving the module, in green, instead of the channels arriving
Shrink channels — drops the muted channels out of the cable altogether instead of silencing them, so the remaining ones move up; no fade is applied in this mode
exclude -10v chans too — while Shrink channels is ticked, also drops any channel sitting at -10V or below
Initialize on Start — comes up with nothing muted when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming the saved mutes
